manual.text:
## Specific task description

Task instruction: Use both arms to lift the kitchenpot with two side handles

Task description: The target is the covered gray pot in the center of the table, with a handle on each side. Use both arms to grasp the left and right handles and lift the entire pot.

Success criteria: The pot is clearly raised with a visible gap between its bottom and the table, opening upward and body approximately upright. The left and right grippers remain near the grasp areas of their corresponding side handles and jointly hold the pot.

## Execution tips

- Consider grasping the outer rod sections of both handles, away from the pot wall, where the pads can make ample contact. Avoid the roots where the handles join the pot body to leave room for the fingers.
- Match the gripper opening to the thickness of the rod section and nearby clearance. Before closing, confirm the fingers are actually on opposite sides of the rod rather than merely overlapping in the image or pressing against the pot wall.
- When both arms bear the load, coordinate lift distance and speed. If one side slips or the pot tilts, slow the lift and adjust the relative heights slightly rather than continuing to raise one side and tipping it further.
